t: Free software that turns music written as text into printed sheet music.
steps: Download LilyPond from the official LilyPond site.
Ask IT to install it on school computers.
Install a text editor such as Frescobaldi to write input files.
Open the manual and copy a short example.
Type a four-note melody and compile it.
Open the printed score and compare it to the text.
Browse the examples gallery for ideas.
